findings.proposedReview: Owns one searchable view-picker interaction: canonical descriptor filtering, active option, local open state, navigation, accessible combobox/listbox presentation and visibility scroll. Global key lifetime is separated into useClientViewKeys and metadata belongs to canonical clientViews. Uses adopted Radix Popover/Next navigation; no persistence, API, authority, custom overlay engine or speculative destination. Keeping option rendering with local filter state makes keyboard selection auditable without a speculative generic command abstraction.
